🔥 अरे भाई! बॉलीवुड के हमारे हिमेश भाई ने तो इंटरनेशनल लेवल पर तहलका मचाने की पूरी तैयारी कर ली है भाई लोग! 😎

इंटरव्यू के दौरान कोमल नाहटा से बातचीत में हिमेश रेशमिया ने बड़ा खुलासा किया है। 🎤

हिमेश ने बताया कि उन्होंने इंटरनेशनल अंग्रेजी एल्बम के लिए पूरे १५ गाने लिख लिए हैं, गाए हैं और खुद कंपोज किए हैं। 🎵

उनका दावा है कि ये गाने बिल्कुल भी wannabe नहीं लगते हैं और इन्हें बहुत बड़े पैमाने पर ग्लोबली लॉन्च किया जाएगा। 🌍

ब्लूमबर्ग की दुनिया के टॉप पॉप स्टार्स की लिस्ट में आने के बाद हिमेश का कहना है कि एल्बम लॉन्च करने का यह बिल्कुल सही समय है। 📈

हिमेश ने यह भी खुलासा किया कि अगर उन्हें मौका मिला, तो उनके पास एक ऐसा गाना है जो बिल्कुल Rihanna के लिए सही है। 🤩

क्या आप हिमेश रेशमिया के इन अंग्रेजी गानों को सुनने के लिए बेताब हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.text:
Himesh Reshammiya recently had a conversation with Komal Nahta and revealed that he has already composed 15 songs for his international English-language album. He further stated that once he is free from his prior commitments, he would like to launch the album on a grand scale.
Himesh Reshammiya was asked if there was any international singer with whom he would like to collaborate. Before answering the question, the singer-composer made an interesting revelation. He said, “Nobody knows that I have composed 15 songs in the international language, which absolutely do not sound wannabe in any manner whatsoever. I have written, sung and composed those 15 songs in English. They are going to be launched on a very, very big scale. I am waiting to plan for it because I have been tied up with so many things and films.”
Himesh Reshammiya continued, “I’ll launch the album internationally the way I was launched as a singer here. Now that I have entered Bloomberg’s list of top pop stars of the world, this is the right time to present my album. Its first single will be unveiled in a grand fashion globally. So, it’s not like I sang a small part in a global song. It purely targets the universal audience who listens to English music.”
Himesh added, “It’ll be very different. At one point, no one was able to imagine how I would sound when I sang Aashiq Banaya Aapne (2005). The same will happen here. It’s so good and yet again, it has a romantic connection. I am very excited about it.”
Finally, answering the original question about his dream international collaboration, Himesh Reshammiya revealed, “If I get a chance to collaborate, then there’s one song which is absolutely right for Rihanna.”
